en: Vintage Romanian postcard. Front: a black‑and‑white view of a castellated mansion with towers, seen from a park with a large circular fountain, benches and trees; people stroll and sit around the fountain. Back: Romanian 40 BANI blue stamp (POSTA ROMANA) with cancellation marks reading BALC BIHOR, handwritten Romanian message and address. Printed caption at the bottom mentions a sanatorium.
